core_problem.statement: No integrated, offline-first platform exists that lets Ugandan communities collect, analyze, and visualize social network data
core_problem.description: The central problem the project aims to solve

roots.statement: No accessible SNA tools designed for low-literacy, low-tech environments
Lack of investment in local data infrastructure & training
Policy-makers don't recognize the value of network data
Cultural & language barriers in existing international tools
No business model for sustainable data collection at community level

branches.statement: Cooperatives & savings groups can't identify their own influence
NGO & government interventions spread thinly instead of targeted at high-level leverage
Field researchers have no low-cost, offline way to collect network data
Existing SNA tools demand technical skill, constant internet & give no Uganda-specific data

leaf.statement: Persistent exclusion of youth, women & informal workers from data-driven decision-making
Informal economy stays largely invisible to policy & investment despite its economic importance
Parish Development Model / Emyooga interventions under-perform for lack of targeting
